title: Local $p$-Adic Section Conjecture
exact_target: Let $k$ be a local $p$-adic field and $X/k$ a smooth projective curve of genus at least $2$. Is the natural map from $X(k)$ to conjugacy classes of continuous sections of $$\pi_1(X/k)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Gal}(\overline k/k)$$ a bijection?
